description: Test suite for token-related utility functions, including isSilentReplyText, stripSilentToken, and isSilentReplyPrefixText.

methods.name: isSilentReplyText
methods.description: Checks if the given text matches the silent reply token with optional custom token.

methods.name: stripSilentToken
methods.description: Removes the silent reply token from the end of the text if present.

methods.name: isSilentReplyPrefixText
methods.description: Determines whether the given text starts with a prefix indicating a silent reply, with optional custom token.

ctags.name: text
ctags.pattern: /^    const text = "Here is a helpful response.\\n\\nNO_REPLY";$/

ctags.name: text
ctags.pattern: /^    const text = "NO_REPLY but here is more content";$/
